title: Can You Buy a House in GTA 6? Only Garages 🏠 #Shorts
description:
You can't buy a house in GTA 6's story mode. Instead, the story gives you five safehouses: Jason's borrowed place in the Leonida Keys, the Starlet Motel in Port Gellhorn, Boobie's apartment, a free room at the Y Hotel and, in Chapter 5, Pegassi Tower. What you can buy are garages: eight of them, through the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone, from $4,000 (Mitchell Auto Center, Kelly County) to $40,000. They unlock in Chapter 2 after the mission Daily Driver.

Source: VGC (Video Games Chronicle), "Can you buy houses in GTA 6? Property, garages and safehouses explained", Nov 24, 2026.
